Local observability in `wrangler dev` is now on by default, and you can turn it off with an environment variable.

- **Current default:** Wrangler 4.118.0 (July 31, 2026) enabled capture of request traces and console logs by default in dev. Before that change, it was opt-in behind the X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=true flag.
- **How to disable it:** Set `X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=false`. The release notes suggest this for cases where the extra per-worker collector and streaming-tail services cause trouble in a multi-process dev-registry setup.
- **Where the data goes:** The captured traces appear in the Observability tab of the Local Explorer. A read-only SQL endpoint at /cdn-cgi/explorer/api/local/observability/query lets tools and coding agents query the same spans and logs.
- **Agent hint:** When the dev server detects a supported coding-agent session, it prints a hint pointing to the Local Explorer API.

I found these details only in release notes and a Cloudflare blog post, not in the official Wrangler documentation, so check the current docs before relying on the exact variable name in production tooling.

content.text:
Since Wrangler 4.118.0 (July 31, 2026), `wrangler dev` collects request traces and `console` logs by default. Before that you had to opt in with `X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=true`. The data stays on your machine and shows up in the **Observability tab of the Local Explorer**. Tools and coding agents can also read the same spans and logs through a read-only SQL endpoint at `/cdn-cgi/explorer/api/local/observability/query` on your dev server. To turn collection off, set `X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=false` before starting the server. In PowerShell that's `$env:X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY="false"; npx wrangler dev`. I only found this in release notes and a Cloudflare blog post, not in the official Wrangler docs, so check the variable name against your Wrangler version.

Sources:
- [Local observability now on by default (release notes)](https://releases.sh/release/rel_8_P1FMWi7cB_iDXTx-lAU-local-observability-now-on-by-default-dev-shutdown-leaks-fixed)
- [Local dev observability traces/logs SQL query endpoint](https://releases.sh/release/rel_sLBHvKoHq2yYEz_ebczQ4-local-dev-observability-traces-logs-sql-query-endpoint)
- [Cloudflare blog: Your agent can now debug Workers with local tracing](https://blog.cloudflare.com/local-tracing/)
